title.zh: THORChain refuses to block Bitget funds, despite pausing after own hack
title.en: THORChain refuses to block Bitget funds, despite pausing after own hack

current_state.zh: THORChain declined a formal request from Bitget and security firm SlowMist to refuse service to addresses linked to the exchange's over $380 million hack, four months after THORChain paused trading following its own $10 million exploit.
current_state.en: THORChain declined a formal request from Bitget and security firm SlowMist to refuse service to addresses linked to the exchange's over $380 million hack, four months after THORChain paused trading following its own $10 million exploit.
